firm_data.firm_description: Braunstein Turkish LLP is a full service commercial law firm with offices in Woodbury, New York. The firm represents individual and corporate clients in a wide variety of legal matters ranging from Real Estate and Asset Based Lending, Corporate M&A and Private Placement, Commercial Leasing, to Construction and Commercial Litigation.
notable_facts: Founded by Harry Braunstein and William Turkish
Represents clients in New York State and Federal Court commercial litigation

email.subject: AI for Braunstein Turkish LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi William,

You and Harry built Braunstein Turkish on a foundation of commercial real estate transactions and lending work that demands precision and client trust. That's exactly the kind of practice we're built to support.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: accuracy, relationship preservation, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into the New York region. I'd be happy to stop by your Woodbury office on Thursday, April 10 to show how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw, particularly in commercial litigation and real estate work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
